question: Do the commodity legs that passed Stage 0 on ETF series (slv_trend_1h, uso_trend_1h, gld_pullback_1h, gld_pullback_1d) still have positive edge NET OF Velotrade's full cost stack when re-run on the SPOT/CFD price series of the same underlying, and does the surviving book clear the prop EV + survival bar on Velotrade CLASSIC 1-Step $5k?

series.source: Dukascopy 1h bid candles (dukascopy-python==4.0.1 via scripts/ops/fetch_dukascopy_ohlcv.py), 2019-01-01 .. 2026-10-31 UTC. PROXIES for Velotrade's CFDs (spot metal / WTI front-month CFD): Velotrade's own bar feed is not readable until VELO-INSTR-READ.
series.daily_legs: gld_pullback_1d and slv_pullback_1d run the 1d harness on the 1h series resampled to 1d by the harness (--resample 1d). The day boundary is the harness's (UTC), not a vendor daily bar.
series.not_modelled: Velotrade's own quotes, session hours and spreads; DXtrade fill model; the CFD's overnight roll vs the spot series. R-multiples transfer, price paths are not identical.

legs.not_run: Equity-ETF legs (spy_trend_long_1d, qqq_trend_long_1d, qqq_pullback_1h, iwm_trend_long_1d). On the ETF proxies they were negative or inside noise at Velotrade's overnight fee (memo prop-frontier-2026-11-12 section 4: -0.43/-0.19/-0.19R, qqq_trend_long_1d +0.55R on n=5). They need their own unit; this unit is the commodity-first screen PI-0001 asked for.
legs.params: Each leg's EXACT config/strategies.yaml parameters, translated to harness flags by scripts/research/regime_debt_matrix.py::build_harness_cmd (the same call scripts/ops/build_strategy_evidence.py makes). Nothing is tuned. param_selection_provenance stays not_established. A leg whose cfg the harness cannot route is INDETERMINATE (producer_failed), never PASS.
legs.status_note: gld_pullback_1h is enabled:false (INACTIVE, retired 2026-10-28). Its Stage-0 result here is evidence for a re-entry test only; nothing in this unit re-rosters it.

harness_run: Harness runs with --fee-bps-roundtrip 0 and emits per-trade gross_r / mfe_r / entry_time / exit_time; costs are then applied once, by scripts/research/prop_ev_sim.py::build_trades with the CostConfig below, exactly as RULE-PROP-FRONTIER-EV6M-20261112 did. The harness's own slippage constant is NOT double counted: the ledger's gross_r is used.

costs.source: Velotrade 1P (velotrade.com/blog/velotrade-review, fetched 2026-11-12, quoted in docs/research/prop-frontier-2026-11-12.md section 3): commission 0.01% per side on commodities = 2 bps round trip, no spread markup; overnight fee 0.05% of notional at 00:30 UTC on commodities including weekends. The CFD spread is NOT published: slippage_bps_rt 3 stands in for spread + slippage (as in RQ-20261112-09d2-06) and the wide arm (10 bps) stresses it. The 6 bps commission arm is the ev6m screen's deliberately conservative figure.
costs.graded_arm: primary. The two stress arms are reported and never grade a leg.

folds: The leg's trades, ordered by entry_time, are cut into 4 equal-count time folds (the harness_timefolds convention of the evidence records).

leg_rule.statement: A leg PASSES Stage 0 on the CFD series iff, at the PRIMARY cost arm: (a) pooled net R over all its trades > 0 (restates RULE-D1-STAGE0-NET-OF-FULL-COST); AND (b) at least 3 of the 4 time folds have net R > 0; AND (c) n >= 30. n < 30 or a harness failure is INDETERMINATE. Any other outcome is FAIL. The pooled net-R 95% CI (prop_gate.edge_ci, z 1.96) is reported for every leg and is NOT a leg criterion; it is a book criterion below.
leg_rule.robust_flag: A leg that PASSES is additionally marked ROBUST iff its pooled net R is also > 0 on both stress arms. Reported; it does not change the verdict.

book_rule.book: VELO_CFD = the decisive legs whose leg verdict is PASS. descriptive-only books: VELO_CFD_ROBUST (the ROBUST subset); ALL5 (decisive + slv_pullback_1d).
book_rule.simulator: scripts/research/prop_ev_sim.py path mode (with the drawdown_type generalisation of PROP-TRAILING-DD-SIM), ruleset config/prop_rulesets/velotrade_classic_1step.yaml (static 7% drawdown, 4% daily). Settings fixed as RULE-PROP-FRONTIER-EV6M-20261112: horizon 182 days, seeds 1,2,3, 1000 lives, risk 0.5% of start, sizing start, daily-DD switch 0.8, lev cap 5, fresh funded start. Ledger window for the graded cell: the whole 2019-01-01..2026-10-31 ledger (blocks resampled from it). The 2025-06-01.. window is descriptive, for comparability with the ev6m screen.
book_rule.buyable_iff: ALL of: (1) the book has >= 2 PASS legs; (2) min over seeds of ev_net_usd_per_life > 0; (3) mean over seeds EV > the mean zero-edge-null EV (same ledgers re-centred to mean net R 0 under the same costs); (4) the book's pooled net-R 95% CI lower bound > 0; (5) SURVIVAL: mean over seeds of p_breach_max_dd + p_breach_daily_loss (any phase) <= 0.25. Threshold 0.25 is fixed here, before the run (the ev6m screen's CLASSIC cell read 0.143 breach on a 17-month ledger).
book_rule.descriptive_only: PRO 1-Step $5k (3% static, 3% daily, a much tighter plan), the 1% risk arm, the stress cost arms, the 2025-06+ window and the trailing-DD what-if arms below. None can make the plan buyable.
book_rule.trailing_what_if: Descriptive: the same book/ledger/settings on CLASSIC with the 7% drawdown made closed_trailing, eod_trailing and intraday_trailing (lock buffer 1%, lock at start), to show how much of the survival rests on Velotrade's static floor. This is the sensitivity PROP-TRAILING-DD-SIM exists for (Blue Guardian, Tradeify futures). It is not a Velotrade rule: Velotrade's drawdown is static (1P rules page, read 2026-10-04 and in the memo).

what_a_result_does_not_do: Changes no roster, risk, sizing or config; places no order; reads no account id or balance. A BUYABLE verdict is information for the operator's purchase decision and does not satisfy the remaining buy-point conditions of the memo (VELO-INSTR-READ symbols on our login; each leg's comms/prop_survival/<leg>.json under the SUPERSET gate; then the operator chooses a second account or the Tier-3 roster add). A leg PASS is a Stage-0 pass on a PROXY series, not on Velotrade's own feed.
thresholds_fixed: No threshold, arm, window or leg set above is changed after any result is read. A runner defect found after the run is fixed and the run repeated under the same rule, and the defect is recorded.
